# <module dir>:<packages>:<forbidden import path regexp>
# NFR-005: the evaluator and the configuration formats import no telemetry, transport or platform clients.
# NFR-011: the evaluator interfaces carry neither the JsonLogic engine nor the JSON schema library.
core:./pkg/evaluator:opentelemetry|grpc|connectrpc|k8s.io|gocloud|jsonlogic|jsonschema
core:./pkg/evaluator/...:opentelemetry|grpc|connectrpc|k8s.io|gocloud
core:./pkg/configformat/...:opentelemetry|grpc|connectrpc|k8s.io|gocloud|jsonlogic|core/pkg/evaluator|core/pkg/sync/
# The service interfaces and the OFREP models stay light.
core:./pkg/service/...:opentelemetry|grpc|connectrpc|k8s.io|gocloud|jsonlogic|jsonschema
# Q2: the sync providers import no telemetry (blob carries OpenTelemetry through gocloud's own tracing).
core:./pkg/sync/file:go.opentelemetry.io
core:./pkg/sync/grpc:go.opentelemetry.io
core:./pkg/sync/http:go.opentelemetry.io
core:./pkg/sync/kubernetes:go.opentelemetry.io
# Q12: each blob provider pulls only its own cloud's SDK into its package graph; the base none. (gocloud's shared user-agent code
# brings a few cloud.google.com/go/auth packages into every driver that uses it, so azblob names the GCS SDK instead.)
core:./pkg/sync/blob:cloud.google.com|github.com/Azure|github.com/aws
core:./pkg/sync/gcs:github.com/Azure|github.com/aws
core:./pkg/sync/azblob:cloud.google.com/go/storage|github.com/aws
core:./pkg/sync/s3:cloud.google.com|github.com/Azure
